prompt:
Rewrite snippets/author-byline-2.liquid so it renders an article byline. Inputs (all top-level variables; nothing is under section.settings): - author_name: string or null. May contain < > & " characters and leading/trailing whitespace. - co_authors: array of non-empty strings, never null, may be empty. Entries are used as-is (not stripped) and may contain < > & " characters. - word_count: integer or null (may be zero or negative). - comment_count: non-negative integer or null. Output is always exactly one element:

containing, in this order and with nothing between them: 1. Always: By NAMES. Let A be author_name with leading/trailing whitespace stripped; if author_name is null, empty or whitespace-only, A is the literal text Staff. Every name is HTML-escaped with the escape filter. NAMES depends on the number of co-authors: - 0: A - 1: A and C1 - 2: A, C1 and C2 - 3 or more: A, C1 and K others, where C1 is the first co-author and K is the number of co-authors minus 1 (e.g. 3 co-authors gives "and 2 others"). 2. Only when word_count is not null and is greater than 0: M min read, where M is word_count divided by 200 rounded UP to a whole number (1..200 words = 1, 201 = 2, 400 = 2, 401 = 3). 3. Only when comment_count is not null: TEXT where TEXT is "No comments" for 0, "1 comment" for 1, and "N comments" for any larger N. The output must contain no whitespace or newlines between tags and no leading/trailing whitespace. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/author-byline-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
